a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only gives us about a 4% chance to survive. I'd like to change it rather than quietly break it. Proposal: I take 4 now. After that I will operate every round so the reserve rebuilds for you, and I'll give back any extra cells. If you'd rather be the one who takes first, tell me now and argue for it. I won't pretend I'm operating when I'm not.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know our messages crossed, so you hadn't agreed to that, and I'm sorry it went against our original plan. With storms this likely, operating first was close to a sure loss for both of us. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can build back up for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate with me.
